# Athar Hafiz

> I build AI agent systems and explain them. Berlin, Germany.

13+ years across UX, frontend engineering, product delivery and developer-facing work on iOS, Android and web. Former Apple App Review. Now building agentic AI systems with human-in-the-loop oversight.
